export declare const MEMORY_BATCH_MAX_ITEMS = 100;

export declare const MEMORY_CONFIGURE_PERMISSION = "memory:configure";

export declare const MEMORY_CONSUMERS: readonly MemoryConsumer[];

export declare const MEMORY_EXPORT_PERMISSION = "memory:export";

export declare const MEMORY_FORMAL_KINDS: readonly MemoryFormalKind[];

export declare const MEMORY_KINDS: readonly MemoryKind[];

export declare const MEMORY_LIFECYCLES: readonly ["session", "short-term", "long-term"];

export declare const MEMORY_PERMISSIONS: readonly ["memory:read", "memory:recall", "memory:write", "memory:configure", "memory:export"];

export declare const MEMORY_PROVIDER_ID = "system.memory";

export declare const MEMORY_READ_PERMISSION = "memory:read";

export declare const MEMORY_RECALL_PERMISSION = "memory:recall";

export declare const MEMORY_SCENES: readonly ["coding", "assistant", "common"];

export declare const MEMORY_SOURCES: readonly MemorySource[];

export declare const MEMORY_WRITE_PERMISSION = "memory:write";

export interface MemoryApplies {
    plugin_ids?: string[];
    object_kinds?: string[];
    goal_ids?: string[];
    task?: string;
    from?: string;
    until?: string;
}

export type MemoryApproval = {
    by: "person";
} | {
    by: "policy";
    policy: string;
    version: number;
};

export type MemoryBasis = "explicit" | "repeated" | "inferred";

export interface MemoryBatchItem {
    scope: MemoryScope;
    owner: string;
    memory_id: string;
    expected_version: number;
}

export interface MemoryBatchPreview extends MemoryBatchRequest {
    preview_id: string;
    max_items: number;
}

export interface MemoryBatchRequest {
    action: "disable" | "remove";
    items: MemoryBatchItem[];
}

export interface MemoryBatchResult {
    preview_id: string;
    action: MemoryBatchRequest["action"];
    complete: boolean;
    items: Array<MemoryBatchItem & {
        outcome: "completed" | "conflict" | "refused" | "unknown" | "not-executed";
        change_id?: string;
    }>;
}

export interface MemoryCandidate {
    candidate_id: string;
    version: number;
    scope: MemoryScope;
    project_id: string | null;
    kind: MemoryKind;
    text: string;
    applies: MemoryApplies;
    basis: MemoryBasis;
    why: string;
    from: "work" | "extraction" | "signal" | "gate";
    work: {
        work_id: string;
        title: string;
    } | null;
    hold_reason: string | null;
    supersedes: string | null;
    state: "pending" | "accepted" | "discarded" | "expired" | "cancelled";
    created_at: string;
    memory_id: string | null;
}

export interface MemoryCandidateDecision {
    candidate_id: string;
    expected_version: number;
    text?: string;
}

export interface MemoryCandidateRecord extends MemoryCandidate {
    source_refs?: readonly import("services/agent-host-memory").AgentMemorySourceRef[];
    formal_expires_at?: string | null;
    actor_id: string;
    owner: string;
}

export interface MemoryChange {
    change_id: string;
    kind: MemoryChangeKind;
    memory_id: string | null;
    scope: MemoryScope;
    project_id: string | null;
    text: string;
    by: "person" | "policy" | "maintenance" | "assistant";
    rule: string | null;
    reason: string | null;
    work: {
        work_id: string;
        title: string;
    } | null;
    at: string;
    undoable: boolean;
    state: "active" | "undone";
}

export type MemoryChangeKind = "kept" | "auto_kept" | "replaced" | "auto_replaced" | "merged" | "edited" | "restored" | "moved" | "disabled" | "auto_disabled" | "enabled" | "paused" | "resumed" | "removed" | "accepted" | "imported" | "cleared";

export interface MemoryChangeRecord extends MemoryChange {
    operation_id?: string;
    applied_version?: number;
    actor_id: string;
    owner: string;
    undo: MemoryUndoPlan | null;
}

export interface MemoryChangeRequest {
    memory_id: string;
    expected_version?: number;
    action: "renew" | "reclassify" | "update" | "disable" | "enable" | "remove" | "restore" | "move";
    text?: string;
    kind?: MemoryFormalKind;
    classification?: MemoryClassificationCorrection;
    applies?: MemoryApplies;
    expires_at?: string | null;
    version?: number;
    to?: MemoryScope;
}

export interface MemoryChangeResult {
    memory: MemoryItem | null;
    change: MemoryChange;
}

export interface MemoryClassRestriction {
    selector: {
        consumer: MemoryConsumer;
        current_scene: typeof MEMORY_SCENES[number];
        scene?: typeof MEMORY_SCENES[number];
        kind?: MemoryFormalKind;
        lifecycle?: typeof MEMORY_LIFECYCLES[number];
    };
    read: "inherit" | "explicit-only" | "off";
    form: "inherit" | "off";
}

export type MemoryClassification = NonNullable<import("services/agent-host-memory").AgentMemoryMeta["classification"]>;

export interface MemoryClassificationCorrection {
    scenes: ("coding" | "assistant" | "common")[];
    lifecycle: "long-term" | "short-term";
}

export interface MemoryClearResult {
    removed: number;
    complete: boolean;
    items: Array<{
        memory_id: string;
        outcome: "completed" | "already-absent" | "conflict" | "not-executed" | "unknown";
    }>;
}

export type MemoryConsumer = "assistant" | "agent" | "ui" | "plugin" | "mcp";

export interface MemoryEvidence {
    kind: string;
    text?: string;
    ref?: {
        kind: string;
        id: string;
        revision?: string | null;
        project_id?: string | null;
    } | string;
    at: string | null;
}

export interface MemoryEvidenceInput extends Omit<MemoryEvidence, "kind" | "ref" | "at"> {
    kind: "said" | "object" | "work" | "signal";
    ref?: Exclude<MemoryEvidence["ref"], string>;
    at: string;
}

export interface MemoryExportPackage {
    format: "molis.memory";
    version: 2;
    exported_at: string;
    scope: MemoryScope;
    entries: Array<{

        source: MemorySource;

        kind: string;

    }>;
}

export type MemoryFormalKind = MemoryKind | "habit" | "project-decision";

export interface MemoryItem {

export type MemoryKind = "preference" | "convention" | "fact" | "experience";

export interface MemoryLedgerPort {
    forget(memoryId: string): void;
    forgetScopes(input: {
        scopes: ReadonlyArray<{
            scope: MemoryScope;
            owner: string;
        }>;
        project_id: string;
        prefs_keys: readonly string[];
        signal_prefixes: readonly string[];
        marker_keys: readonly string[];
    }): void;
    revisions(memoryId: string): MemoryRevision[];
    addRevision(memoryId: string, revision: MemoryRevision): void;
    candidates(actorId: string): MemoryCandidateRecord[];
    saveCandidate(record: MemoryCandidateRecord): void;
    dropCandidate(candidateId: string): void;
    changes(actorId: string, limit: number): MemoryChangeRecord[];
    changesOf(memoryId: string): MemoryChangeRecord[];
    change(changeId: string): MemoryChangeRecord | null;
    saveChange(record: MemoryChangeRecord): void;
    prefs(actorId: string, key: string): Partial<MemoryPrefs> | null;
    savePrefs(actorId: string, key: string, prefs: MemoryPrefs): void;
    countSignal(input: {
        actor_id: string;
        key: string;
        event_id: string;
        occurrence: string;
        at: string;
    }): {
        state: "counted" | "duplicate";
        count: number;
        distinct: number;
    };
    recordUses(uses: readonly MemoryUseRecord[]): void;
    lastUse(memoryId: string): MemoryUseRecord | null;
    uses(filter: {
        receipt_id?: string;
        work_id?: string;
        memory_id?: string;
        limit?: number;
    }): MemoryUseRecord[];
    owners(projectId: string): Array<{
        scope: MemoryScope;
        owner: string;
        title: string;
        subject: string | null;
    }>;
    noteOwner(input: {
        scope: MemoryScope;
        owner: string;
        project_id: string | null;
        title: string;
        subject?: string | null;
    }): void;
    candidateOwners(projectId: string): Array<{
        scope: MemoryScope;
        owner: string;
    }>;
    pairs(actorId: string): Array<MemoryPair & {
        owner: string;
        state: "pending" | "resolved";
    }>;
    savePair(actorId: string, pair: MemoryPair & {
        owner: string;
        state: "pending" | "resolved";
    }): void;
    marker(actorId: string, key: string): {
        at: string;
        body: unknown;
    } | null;
    setMarker(actorId: string, key: string, body: unknown, at: string): void;
    transaction<T>(work: () => T): T;
    close(): void;
}

export interface MemoryPair {
    pair_id: string;

export interface MemoryPrefs {
    enabled: boolean;
    task_recall: boolean;
    form: boolean;
    auto: boolean;
    learn_from_work: boolean;
    learn_from_ui: boolean;

        allowed: boolean;

}

export interface MemoryPrefsView {
    scope: MemoryScope;
    project_id: string | null;
    prefs: MemoryPrefs;
}

export type MemoryPrefsWriteRequest = {
    scope?: MemoryScope;
} & ({
    prefs: Partial<MemoryPrefs>;
    preset?: never;
} | {
    preset: MemoryPreset;
    prefs?: never;
});

export type MemoryPreset = "off" | "manual" | "reviewed" | "assisted";

export interface MemoryRecallResponse {

        scope: MemoryScope;
        reason: "budget" | "limit" | "conflict";

export interface MemoryRevision {
    snapshot?: {
        origin: string;
        meta: import("services/agent-host-memory").AgentMemoryMeta;
    };
    version: number;
    text: string;
    kind: MemoryFormalKind;
    applies: MemoryApplies;

}

}

export interface MemorySignalReport {
    event_id: string;
    signal: "accepted" | "ignored" | "rewritten" | "undone";
    subject: {
        capability_id: string;
        label: string;
    };
    situation?: {
        plugin_id?: string;
        object_kind?: string;
        label?: string;
    };
    occurrence?: string;
    scope?: MemoryScope;
}

export interface MemorySignalResult {
    state: "counted" | "duplicate" | "off";
    count: number;
    distinct: number;
    candidate_id: string | null;
    threshold: {
        count: number;
        distinct: number;
    };
}

export type MemorySource = "said" | "accepted" | "auto" | "imported" | "manual" | "plugin";

export type MemoryState = "active" | "disabled" | "paused";

export type MemoryUndoPlan = {
    action: "remove";
} | {
    action: "restore";
    version: number;
} | {
    action: "enable";
    clear_expiry?: boolean;
} | {
    action: "disable";
} | {
    action: "pause";
    change_id: string;
} | {
    action: "recreate";
    text: string;
    kind: MemoryFormalKind;
    source: MemorySource;
    basis: MemoryBasis | null;
    applies: MemoryApplies;
    snapshot?: MemoryRevision["snapshot"];
    source_refs?: readonly {
        event_id: string;
        version: string;
    }[];
};

export interface MemoryUpkeepReport {
    at: string;
    expired: number;
    unused: number;
    merged: number;
    paused: number;
    resumed: number;
    pairs: number;
    tidied: boolean;
}

export interface MemoryUse {
    at: string;
    consumer: MemoryConsumer;
    title: string;
    work_id?: string;
}

export interface MemoryUseRecord {
    memory_id: string;
    receipt_id: string;
    at: string;
    consumer: MemoryConsumer;
    title: string;
    work_id: string | null;
    state: "used" | "returned" | "omitted" | "not-dispatched" | "dispatched-or-unknown" | "response-observed";
    source?: "recall" | "run-context";
    run?: {
        session_id: string;
        run_id: string;
    };
    memory_version?: number;
    evidence_call_id?: string;
    time_basis?: "run-start";
}

export interface MemoryWriteRequest {
    scope: MemoryScope;
    text: string;
    kind?: MemoryKind;
    applies?: MemoryApplies;
    said?: string;
    rests_on?: {
        kind: string;
        id: string;
    };
    expires_at?: string | null;
    replaces?: string;
}

export interface MemoryWriteResult {
    outcome: "written" | "replaced" | "duplicate" | "candidate" | "refused";
    reason: string;
    applies_text: string;
    memory: MemoryItem | null;
    candidate: MemoryCandidate | null;
    change_id: string | null;
}

export declare const memoryActions: {
    page: ActionDefinition<import("services/memory-queries").MemoryPageRequest, import("services/memory-queries").MemoryPageResponse>;
    recall: ActionDefinition<MemoryRecallRequest, MemoryRecallResponse>;
    list: ActionDefinition<MemoryListRequest, MemoryListResponse>;
    write: ActionDefinition<MemoryWriteRequest, MemoryWriteResult>;
    change: ActionDefinition<MemoryChangeRequest, MemoryChangeResult>;
    history: ActionDefinition<{
        memory_id: string;
    }, MemoryHistoryResponse>;
    candidates: ActionDefinition<{
        scope?: MemoryScope | "all";
        work_id?: string;
    }, {
        candidates: MemoryCandidate[];
    }>;
    accept: ActionDefinition<MemoryCandidateDecision, {
        candidate: MemoryCandidate;
        memory: MemoryItem | null;
    }>;
    discard: ActionDefinition<Pick<MemoryCandidateDecision, "candidate_id" | "expected_version">, {
        candidate: MemoryCandidate;
    }>;
    changes: ActionDefinition<{
        scope?: MemoryScope | "all";
        work_id?: string;
        limit?: number;
    }, {
        changes: MemoryChange[];
    }>;
    undo: ActionDefinition<{
        change_id: string;
    }, {
        change: MemoryChange;
    }>;
    prefs: ActionDefinition<{
        scope?: MemoryScope;
    }, MemoryPrefsView>;
    savePrefs: ActionDefinition<MemoryPrefsWriteRequest, MemoryPrefsView>;
    signal: ActionDefinition<MemorySignalReport, MemorySignalResult>;
    pairs: ActionDefinition<{
        scope?: MemoryScope | "all";
    }, {
        pairs: MemoryPair[];
    }>;
    resolvePair: ActionDefinition<{
        pair_id: string;
        keep: "a" | "b" | "both";
    }, {
        resolved: boolean;
    }>;
    upkeep: ActionDefinition<Record<string, never>, MemoryUpkeepReport>;
    preview: ActionDefinition<{
        scope: MemoryScope;
    }, MemoryScopePreview>;
    clear: ActionDefinition<{
        scope: MemoryScope;
        fingerprint: string;
    }, MemoryClearResult>;
    export: ActionDefinition<{
        scope: MemoryScope;
    }, {
        package: MemoryExportPackage;
    }>;
    import: ActionDefinition<{
        scope: MemoryScope;
        package: MemoryExportPackage;
    }, MemoryImportResult>;
    batchPreview: ActionDefinition<import("services/memory-batches").MemoryBatchRequest, import("services/memory-batches").MemoryBatchPreview>;
    batchApply: ActionDefinition<{
        preview_id: string;
    }, import("services/memory-batches").MemoryBatchResult>;
};
